controller: MPS100 timeout-rate feedback target1%, no duty floor

trace.trigger: parent NVTX range evoserve_trace_5s at common request origin; no parent CUDA context

kernel_profile.condition: training alone after concurrent measurement; excluded from SLO windows

milestones.gpu_start: after all measurements and CPU checks

prototype_user_confirmed.predictor: fixed seven-task mean normalized action-only learning curve + recent real production episodes; fit gain amplitude and time scale at validations

ranking.validation_uses: prediction at current trained steps only

robot_pacing.miss: continue previous remainder, then zero displacement with previous gripper command
robot_pacing.simulation_overruns: record; do not stretch request clock; lower robot count during capacity selection
robot_pacing.observation: latest completed CPU camera observation; record actual capture frame and age; labels are actual actions starting at that frame
robot_pacing.reset: missed nominal periods remain in SLO denominator
robot_pacing.capacity_gate: SLO >= .99, P99 <= 1.05 matched-arrival no-simulator baseline, no simulation overrun cycles
